name.value: Delta Burnaby Hotel and Conference Centre

description.value: The Delta Burnaby Hotel and Conference Centre is a 189-room, 4-star hotel operated by Marriott on Dominion Street in Burnaby, BC. It includes a dedicated conference centre, making it a major venue for events and business travel in the Metro Vancouver area. Cyclists staying here are within reach of Burnaby's urban trail network and the broader Lower Mainland cycling infrastructure.

raw_osm.name: Delta Burnaby Hotel and Conference Centre

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The fetched website is the global Delta Hotels by Marriott brand homepage (deltahotels.marriott.com), not the specific Burnaby property page. It confirms the hotel exists by listing 'Delta Hotels Burnaby Conference Centre, Burnaby, Canada' in its North America locations. No property-specific amenity details (bike storage, laundry, Wi-Fi, etc.) are available from the website content. OSM tags supply the core property facts (189 rooms, 4-star, phone, address, free internet access, wheelchair accessible, check_date 2025-11-17), but per the rules, OSM amenity tags are not treated as authoritative without website confirmation.
concerns: OSM website URL points to the brand homepage (deltahotels.marriott.com) rather than a property-specific page, so no property-level amenity details could be confirmed from the website content.
Name discrepancy: OSM lists 'Delta Burnaby Hotel and Conference Centre' but the brand website lists it as 'Delta Hotels Burnaby Conference Centre'.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A real, open, 4-star Marriott-operated hotel confirmed active as of November 2025 and listed on the brand's own website. Clearly belongs in the directory as accommodation for touring cyclists.
